title: How industry leaders are driving online sales - Accelerate with Google US

facts.fact: Google's case study page reports that Grammarly's subscription revenue rose 29% and its ROAS rose 23% after using AI-powered search (Google-published case study, not independently verified).
facts.quote: Grammarly boosts subscription revenue 29% and ROAS 23% with AI-powered search

facts.fact: Google's case study page reports that Marks & Spencer exceeded its forecasted ROAS by 186% using Demand Gen (Google-published case study, not independently verified).
facts.quote: Marks & Spencer exceeds forecasted ROAS by 186% with Demand Gen

facts.fact: Google's case study page reports that Caraway achieved a 46% revenue increase and 31% better ROAS by using Performance Max (Google-published case study, not independently verified).
facts.quote: Caraway cooks up 46% revenue increase at 31% better ROAS with Performance Max

facts.fact: According to the page, Lookalike audiences is a feature exclusive to Demand Gen.
facts.quote: including the new Lookalike audiences feature, exclusive to Demand Gen.

facts.fact: The Google Ads account creation notice states that multiple campaigns can be created in the same account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.
